messages.subject: Sustainability Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Stakeholder Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Jill,

Fraxim Search's work across sustainability and purpose-led leadership makes this a relevant introduction for senior executive mandates.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans ESG and social performance, government and regulatory relations, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a major natural-resources operation.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where sustainability strategy, stakeholder confidence, regulatory credibility and responsible growth must be managed together. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC, while I remain internationally mobile for global roles.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for relevant current or future searches across ESG, sustainability, responsible business, external affairs and stakeholder leadership.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
